semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only exact profile terms plus profile-local context, or a direct requester definition, create hard duties. Crime, violence, blood, injury, death, horror, noir, gang, war, revenge, corruption, fear, red, dark, weapon, prison, and police tape remain candidate-only by themselves.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: Selected concepts are expressed as actor or source, specific target, action or coercive mechanism, and localized consequence or documentary trace. A mood, costume, prop, label, or aftermath alone is not a substitute.
semantic_policy.legal_claim_boundary: Genocide intent, protected status, official authority, valid consent, minor status, trafficking purpose, terrorism purpose, and legal execution subtype must come from the authorial core or requester-provided context; pixels can support but not independently adjudicate them.
semantic_policy.reference_boundary: A supplied portrait may guide only visible adult appearance, hair, expression, and framing; it never supplies identity, protected-group membership, victim status, offender status, consent, age, personality, nationality, health, or legal facts.

review_scope: Former prose-only policy and representation declarations preserved without granting runtime authority.
